concept: Weak randomness on Ethereum: public or influenceable block values used as secret entropy
scene: Technical card on a deep navy background. A simple diagram shows three block fields (timestamp, blockhash, difficulty) as open boxes feeding into a winner-selection function, with an amber warning marker on the arrows. Clean line work, monospace labels, ample spacing.
overlay_text: Creating a strong source of randomness on Ethereum is challenging.
alt_text: Diagram of block.timestamp, blockhash and block.difficulty feeding into a winner-selection function, with an amber warning marker showing these values are influenceable.
